summary: Iter-2 minimal fixes (run-5 condition B): predicate insAtOrAboveThr changed from goreq(ins,THR) sensor call to direct comparison ins >= ChemConstants.THR (fixes FDR4 Int/Bool type error and Dafny goreq arity error); added result_codegen.json trace rows for Actuator.java and Clock.java (fixes coverage).

issues.title: Threshold guard uses direct >= comparison instead of goreq() call
issues.detail: CD-GA-FR4/Beh6/Beh7 specify the guard as goreq(ins, thr). The ETL mis-extracts a sensor-method call inside a named predicate (it became an untyped Sensors var), so the guard is now the semantically identical 'ins >= ChemConstants.THR'. GasAnalyzer.goreq remains as the CD-Fn4 implementation.

issues.title: No Final states: GA 'Done' and MV 'Found' are terminal live modes
issues.detail: CD-GA-Beh6 and CD-MV-Beh9 specify transitions to final state j1. The Isabelle theory generator cannot prove deadlock-freedom for a machine with a Final state (CLAUDE.md), so: GasDetected -[goreq(ins,thr)]-> Done (still sends stop), with Done self-looping on gas; Found self-loops on stop instead of transitioning to j1 (flag is still emitted on Found entry). Both self-loops are event-triggered bare-precondition operations.

issues.title: Odometer modeled as zero-arg Vehicle sensor method, not an event
issues.detail: CD-Evt3 specifies odometer as an event consumed in entry actions (odometer ? d0). The single-method step() pattern cannot receive a second event inside an entry action, so d0/d1 are captured via 'd0 = vehicle.odometer()' assignments, which the M2M maps to a Sensors-interface variable.

issues.title: TARGET_CHEM constant and analysis() semantics
issues.detail: The spec does not say how a reading 'indicates the target chemical'. Invented: a GasSensor entry indicates the target iff its c field equals ChemConstants.TARGET_CHEM (=1). analysis returns gasD iff any entry matches.

issues.title: angle() index-to-direction mapping
issues.detail: CD-DM7/CD-Fn3 reference an angle(x) function mapping 1-based sensor index to direction but do not give the mapping. Invented: 1->Front, 2->Left, 3->Right, otherwise Back. Empty readings: intensity()=0.0, location()=Front (safe defaults per the sensor-layer rule).

issues.title: Chem and Intensity represented as int(nat) / double(real)
issues.detail: CD-DM4/CD-DM5 define opaque types; the pipeline has no opaque-type construct, so Chem = int @RoboChartType("nat") and Intensity = double @RoboChartType("real") in the GasSensor record.

issues.title: Constant values set to 1 / 1.0
issues.detail: CD-Const1..6 say values are configured at startup but give no numbers. All set to 1 (nat) / 1.0 (real) to keep the FDR4 state space within the {0..1} type ranges.

issues.title: Waiting during-action randomWalk() as top-of-mode statement
issues.detail: CD-MV-FR1 specifies randomWalk() as a during action. The extraction pattern supports top-of-mode statements (which become entry actions); vehicle.randomWalk() is placed at the head of the Waiting mode block.
